title: Dia Browser footer
description: A spare cream footer set entirely in small uppercase mono with wide tracking: ink column titles over grey links that darken on hover (four columns and a small mark on desktop, two by two on phones), a hairline, then the copyright at the left and a two-line credit centred.
notes: needs a mono typeface in the theme (font-mono)
100px top padding on desktop leaves room under a docked diabrowser-waitlist-dock bar
name: diabrowser-footer

props.name: columns
props.description: up to four link columns (two per row on phones)

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark at the far right on desktop (a symbol or stacked wordmark)

props.name: credit
props.description: the centred credit, one entry per line
